prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 16-bit pixel art for a 2D side-scrolling exploration action game, rich 4-6 shade ramps, dark 1 pixel outlines, crisp square pixels all on ONE consistent grid, no antialiasing, no soft effects, no letters/numbers/logos/watermarks, no resemblance to existing characters or games. Cyan #57d8ff means water/ice with teardrop/crystal shape; orange #ffac63 means fire with forked flame shape. Shape must identify affinity without reading. All assets fully visible and contained in exact equal cells. Use a flat solid background #182130 everywhere outside assets, no labels or separators. PLAYER SPRITE SHEET ONLY. Image 1536x1024. Exactly 9 columns and 2 rows; cell centers at x=(column+0.5)*1536/9 and y=256,768. Row 1 cyan ice form, row 2 orange fire form of the SAME small robot explorer. Side view facing right. Each sprite occupies about 65% cell width, 65% cell height, feet at 85% cell height. A sprite's conceptual native resolution is 20x26 pixels; render enlarged grid blocks consistently. Columns 1-2 idle, 3-6 running with clear alternating legs and arms, 7 jumping, 8 shooting arm cannon, 9 hit recoil. Same head body armor and proportions across all frames. Round helmet with a dark teal visor, small pack, chunky boots, arm cannon, central affinity emblem; icy crown vs forked flame crest. No labels.

Exactly 6 columns, 2 rows in equal 256x512 cells. Row 1 cyan, row 2 orange. Sprite centers x=128,384,640,896,1152,1408 and y=256,768; occupy about 65% cell width and 50% cell height. Side view facing left. Native concept 24x26 pixels each. Columns: 1 walking armored turret with two mechanical legs and long cannon; 2 stationary laser turret with lens; 3 bomb thrower with throwing arm and round bomb; 4 wall builder with brick shield and manipulator; 5 hovering drone with two wings and lower engine; 6 transforming enemy with segmented unfolding shell. Each recognizable by silhouette. Shared dark mechanical plating with ice crystal or flame crest and affinity core. No labels.

Row 1 green water canal: moss and stone, dark masonry; row 2 amethyst corridor: violet crystal cave, angular stone; row 3 ash ruins: charcoal stone and glowing embers. No perspectives, straight tile edges, no labels. Individual cells must not have decorative borders. Seamless repeated textures.
